summary: Iteration 37: iOS Bug Fixes Testing (Web Version) - All web flows verified working. iOS-specific fixes (InlineCalendar, BulletTextArea bullets on Enter, image picker with 3 options) are Platform.OS !== 'web' branches that cannot be tested on web. Web behavior unchanged and working correctly.

create-report.tsx.details: Web uses HTML <select> for OS dropdown (lines 152-165) and HTML input type='date' for date fields (lines 191-199, 223-231). Native uses InlineCalendar component (lines 13-58) with Modal-based OS picker. Both branches working correctly.

edit-report.tsx.details: BulletTextArea component (lines 35-80): Web uses textarea with keyDown handler for Enter key (lines 42-49). Native uses handleNativeChange with regex replacement for auto-bullets (lines 62-77). triggerFileUpload (lines 200-303): Web uses input type='file', Native shows Alert.alert with Camera/Library/File options.

create-timesheet.tsx.details: InlineCalendar (lines 34-68) and InlineTimePicker (lines 72-87) render directly within entry form modal's ScrollView. openInlinePicker() (lines 285-289) toggles visibility states. All pickers render inline without separate Modal wrappers.

edit-timesheet.tsx.details: Same InlineCalendar and InlineTimePicker pattern as create-timesheet.tsx. Pickers render inline within the entry form modal.

pdfHelper.ts.details: Uses expo-file-system/legacy (line 3). Double-token prevention (line 31): checks !apiUrl.includes('token=') before adding. Ensures /api/ prefix (line 29). PDF download working - tested endpoint returns 200 with application/pdf content-type.
